summary: Well‑executed, transparently preregistered confirmatory paired study comparing a GVR pipeline to a single‑pass LLM on a deterministic synthetic NetOps benchmark. Execution and archival provenance are comprehensive and the null/ceiling outcome is clearly explained. The manuscript is mostly sound and reproducible given the supplied artifact bundle, but a few mandatory clarifications are required (all resolvable from archived artifacts) before the submission can be finalized.
critical_issues: Missing explicit identification of the single discordant episode and of the single repair provider trace: the manuscript states these are archived but does not report the concrete pair identifier and the trace artifact path and/or SHA that allow an auditor to deterministically locate the record in execution/raw_results.jsonl.

The preregistered secondary estimands (e.g., effect_size_Cohen_h_equivalent_for_paired_proportions) appear in the preregistration but are absent from the archived analysis results; the manuscript must explicitly disclose which preregistered secondary analyses were not executed and why, and state consequences for interpretation.

The inferential reporting relies on an exact McNemar two‑sided p=1.0 which is correct given the contingency table but is uninformative under the observed ceiling; the paper should include one concise sentence tying the observed discordant counts (n10=1, n01=0) to the p‑value behavior and emphasizing that the paired bootstrap CI (already reported) better conveys practical uncertainty in this context.
required_revisions: Add the exact discordant pair identifier (pair_id) and the corresponding repair provider trace artifact location and SHA256 (or exact index into execution/raw_results.jsonl) into the manuscript text so auditors can deterministically retrieve the single repair invocation and verify the pairing; cite the archived execution manifest path that cross‑references it.

Explicitly state which preregistered secondary estimands/analyses were not executed (or not archived) and why (e.g., analysis artifacts empty or infeasible due to ceiling/margins); if any preregistered analyses were omitted, add a short disclosure sentence in Methods/Results noting omission and its interpretive consequence.

Add one concise explanatory sentence (in Results or Discussion) that links the contingency counts (n11=299, n10=1, n01=0, n00=0) to the exact McNemar two‑sided p=1.0 outcome and state why this p‑value is uninformative here (very small number of discordant pairs) and why the bootstrap CI is reported as the more informative uncertainty summary.
optional_revisions: Reduce repetitive manifest/hash listings in the main narrative by moving some provenance details to a compact paragraph or footnote (keeping all artifacts archived and referenced).

If space allows, briefly (one paragraph) summarize the single discordant episode’s validator diagnostics (high‑level failure mode) to illustrate what the lone repair accomplished; ensure this summary matches archived validator trace content.
Consider adding the preregistered Cohen‑h equivalent effect‑size computation to the analysis artifacts (or state why computation was not run) — this is optional and not required for reproducibility.
